threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts center computers and the synced shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security awareness training; signature antivirus only, with alerts read in business hours; sync client would carry encrypted files into the shared drive and then into the backup; backup never restore-tested
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: Annual training plus quarterly phishing simulations for staff and contractor tutors; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alert monitoring; 90-day immutable backup versions; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Theft of the "Student files" folder (evaluation reports, IEP or 504 plan excerpts, district rosters) during a ransomware attack leads to a reportable breach and a district contract breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Most sensitive documents kept in one shared-drive folder open to all staff; no inventory of where children's information lives; no alerts for mass downloads
existing_controls: Suite MFA; folder not shared outside the company
treatment_plan: Move accommodation notes into the platform and limit the folder to the Center Director and Director of Tutoring; inventory of children's data; suite alerts for mass download and forwarding rules; EDR (R-001)

threat_event: Takeover of a tutor or administrator account in the tutoring platform exposes children's records and recordings, or lets an outsider message children
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA not enforced in the platform; 14 contractor tutors sign in from unmanaged personal computers; 4 administrator accounts
existing_controls: Unique accounts; platform limits tutors to assigned students; messaging visible to Lead Tutors
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all tutors and administrators; reduce administrators to 2; contractor device rules and attestations (POL-02 B.9)

threat_event: Former contractor tutor or employee keeps access to children's information after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offboarding checklist; no account review; three former contractor tutors found with active platform accounts
existing_controls: Accounts disabled 2026-07-15; platform log showed no sign-ins after their last session
treatment_plan: Offboarding checklist on the last day for staff and contractor tutors; monthly account reconciliation against the contractor roster

threat_event: District roster spreadsheets on contractor tutors' personal computers and inboxes are lost, stolen, or forwarded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rosters emailed to every program tutor; no device rules; contractor agreement has no confidentiality or security terms
existing_controls: Rosters sent only to program tutors
treatment_plan: Stop roster emails; each tutor sees only assigned students in the platform; contractors delete old rosters and attest; new contractor agreement with confidentiality, device, and 1-hour incident reporting terms

threat_event: FTC enforcement or a parent complaint because children's information is collected without compliant notice and verifiable parental consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generic online notice; enrollment check box without 312.4(c)(1) content; trial accounts created before consent; no separate consent for disclosures that are not integral; no written security program by the April 22, 2026 compliance date
existing_controls: Card payment at enrollment (a listed consent method, 312.5(b)(2)(ii))
treatment_plan: Rewrite the online notice and direct notice; consent step before any account is created; no trial accounts before consent; adopt the written security program (P02 and P06)

threat_event: Records of about 1,900 former students and every online session recording since 2019 are kept indefinitely, enlarging any breach and breaking the retention rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written retention policy; platform default keeps everything
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Written retention schedule in POL-04 4.9; recordings deleted after 90 days; former students' records deleted 2 years after the last session; district data deleted 60 days after contract end; first purge with deletion record

threat_event: Platform vendor uses children's information to train or improve its AI models without separate parental consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI progress insights module switched on by the vendor; standard terms allow de-identified data for model improvement; data processing addendum unsigned
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Module turned off 2026-08-28; sign a data processing addendum that bars model training and requires written security assurances; restart only under the P10 conditions

threat_event: AI progress risk score leads to unfair program placement or unneeded extra-session recommendations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score used in district placement and parent recommendations with no written review rule, no accuracy or fairness check, and no notice to parents
existing_controls: Director of Tutoring reviews placements informally
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: human decision on every placement, accuracy and fairness check, parent notice; no exit from the district program based on the score

threat_event: Shared drive or email data cannot be restored after deletion or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or deletion of backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 days of versions; not immutable; one MSP admin account without MFA; never restore-tested; no export of platform or scheduling data
existing_controls: Nightly backup by the MSP
treatment_plan: MFA on the backup console; 90-day immutable versions; first restore test by 2026-09-30, then quarterly; monthly export of platform progress data and weekly schedule export

threat_event: Tutoring platform outage longer than the 4-hour RTO for online sessions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO is 8 hours; no written downtime steps for online sessions
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 controls for availability
treatment_plan: Downtime steps: staff-hosted suite video meetings with recording off; parent message template; include in the contingency plan

threat_event: Internet outage at the center stops scheduling and in-person platform use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Contractor tutors teach online from home lines
treatment_plan: Phone hotspot procedure now; cellular failover router at the next MSP contract renewal

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every company computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP agent on every computer; no evidence of MSP MFA or technician list; MSP contract has no security or incident notice terms
existing_controls: MSP contract
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (MFA, technician list, subcontractors); contract amendment with 24-hour incident notice and a recovery commitment

threat_event: Infected student or parent device on the shared Wi-Fi segment attacks staff laptops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Student and guest Wi-Fi on the staff segment; guest password posted at the front desk
existing_controls: Firewall; antivirus on company laptops
treatment_plan: Separate the student and guest network with client isolation; rotate passwords; change the staff Wi-Fi password yearly and when someone leaves

threat_event: Staff or contractor tutors do not recognize or report an incident in time to meet the district's 48-hour notice and the Florida deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident reporting rule or runbook before this engagement; no training
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook (approved 2026-08-28); reporting rule in training and in the new contractor agreement; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Someone posing as a parent obtains or deletes a child's information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Review and deletion requests handled by email without checking the requester is the parent
existing_controls: Requests answered only to the email address on the family account (usually)
treatment_plan: Written parent request procedure: verify through the parent portal sign-in or a call-back to the number on file; log each request

threat_event: Theft of the unencrypted front-desk desktop exposes cached intake files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Front-desk desktop not encrypted; files downloaded from the shared drive
existing_controls: Center locked with alarm
treatment_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption and a screen lock with individual sign-in

threat_event: A tutor misuses online messaging or sessions to contact a child inappropriately
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor tutors work alone online from home; recordings and messages reviewed only after a complaint
existing_controls: Background screening and child-safety training; messages visible to Lead Tutors; sessions recorded
treatment_plan: Monthly spot review of a sample of messages and recordings by Lead Tutors; rule that tutors never contact students outside the platform (POL-02 C.7)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the learning center for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single site; no written continuity steps
existing_controls: SaaS services are off site; online sessions possible from home
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: move sessions online, parent message template, laptops taken home before landfall

threat_event: Scheduling platform outage or data loss with no company copy of the schedule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No stated RTO or RPO; no export
existing_controls: Vendor states daily backups
treatment_plan: Accept the residual risk with a weekly printed schedule export (in place from 2026-09)

threat_event: Session recording link or progress report sent to the wrong parent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recordings shared by link; no recipient check
existing_controls: Platform sends reports to the account on file
treatment_plan: Turn off shareable recording links; share only through the parent portal; training

threat_event: Staff or contractor tutors paste student work or names into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI tools before POL-04 4.6; tutors use chatbots to make worksheets
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-04 4.6 approved-tools rule; training; worksheets made without student details

threat_event: Lost or stolen company laptop exposes children's information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel with staff
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all 7 laptops; data mostly in SaaS
treatment_plan: Accept: encryption makes the data unusable (Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)2.)

threat_event: Attacker reaches the firewall's internet-facing management page and takes over the center network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Management page open to the internet with a password only (found in P07 testing on 2026-08-04)
existing_controls: Strong password
treatment_plan: MSP turned off internet-facing management on 2026-08-06; verified by the assessor on 2026-08-06
